checkpoint.title: Saffron to Silph Co.: 3F's pad to 9F's, 9F's to 5F's corridor, the CARD KEY

events.why: out of Saffron's Center, along the city to Silph Co.'s door (33, 30), up its stairs (1F (31, 2), 2F (28, 2)) to 3F and west along the hall to (5, 6), a tile east of the warp pad (4, 6); the hall keeps clear of the Rocket at (25, 9), who faces west along row 9 (pokeguy bikes in and climbs to 3F, 1:27:44)
onto the pad (4, 6), which warps to 5F's (15, 7) (SilphCo_3F map.json warp 1)

checkpoint: Starts at Saffron's nurse, facing her, where 15.01 ends (healed there, so no Max Elixir or Super Potion on 5F as pokeguy's low-HP run has). Ends on 5F's pad (15, 7), where the pad from 3F leaves the player.

PokeGuy (1:27:44 to 1:28:14): stairs to 3F, warp pads via 5F and briefly 9F, back to the 5F corridor, the CARD KEY at 1:28:11. His pad coordinates were not measured; these are read from the decomp (SilphCo_3F, 5F and 9F map.json warps): 3F (4, 6) to 5F (15, 7), then 5F (10, 20) to 9F (22, 18) and back (the pad pair is the only way into 5F's bottom corridor; the Rocket at 3F (25, 9), facing west along row 9, blocks the other way round to 3F's west rooms).

Next (16.02, not authored): 5F (15, 7) down column 10 to (10, 19), the pad (10, 20), a step off 9F's pad (22, 18) and back on, east along the corridor to the CARD KEY (22, 21). Open: Beau, the scientist who wanders 5F (10..12, 5..7) with sight 1, sees every way from (15, 7) to column 9 or 10 (the walk cannot tell where he would stop the player: a wait or a battle is needed); the Rocket at (9, 21) looks up and right, and (12, 21) is in his line; and the Card Key doors (5F bg_events (8, 9), (8, 10), (8, 18), (8, 19)) are open tiles on the pack's map, so a planned route could cross a closed door.
